caption: Meet HealthGraph. One place for the pieces of your health history: the daily report, your records, fingertip measurements, answers you can check, and voice check-ins. Your history, connected in one graph. Learn more at healthgraph.shop. #healthgraph #meethealthgraph #selftracking #healthdiary #pulsetracking #digitaldiary #healthtech #connectedhealth #wellness #personalhistory

lines.beat: brand open: healthgraph wordmark and graph-pulse mark form on deep navy, warm charcoal vignette

lines.text: Your health history is scattered: notes, files, half-remembered days.
lines.beat: fragmented objects float: PDF, NOTE, MEDICATION, SYMPTOM, MEASUREMENT cards drift in depth layers

lines.text: The idea is simple: connected context, not disconnected entries.
lines.beat: fragments are pulled into one HEALTHGRAPH hub node, green edges draw between them

lines.text: Start anywhere: twenty health areas on one screen.
lines.beat: explore grid: 20 health-area tiles ripple into place, header healthgraph graph-pulse mark

lines.text: The daily report opens each day: pulse, sleep, mood, on one card.
lines.beat: daily-report: cream paper card 3 OCT lifts up, Pulse 59 BPM Fair entry, tabs Daily Logs Records Symptoms

lines.text: Records stay real files, ready to ask about.
lines.beat: records-upload: teal upload button, PDF PNG JPG max 50 MB, file cards dock into Past uploads

lines.text: Measure pulse on your fingertip, then watch it land on the timeline.
lines.beat: pulse-measurement: green sensor trace, 67 BPM FINGERTIP, Saved and synced, node drops into the health graph

lines.text: Ask your records a question and open the entries behind the answer.
lines.beat: ai-chat: question typed, answer card slides in, source cards appear behind it with connector lines

lines.text: When typing isn't enough, speak to the pulse button instead.
lines.beat: home-dashboard: red voice pulse FAB pulses, drawer shows Voice check-in tile

lines.text: Your history, connected in one place, one graph.
lines.beat: health-graph: camera glides through 12 nodes and 22 connections, legend Event Visit Heart Sleep Nutrition

lines.text: No ads, no noise. Just your health, connected.
lines.beat: orbit recedes, clean dark frame, wordmark centered
end card: healthgraph.shop wordmark, Learn more
